title: THE MASK CAN COPY THE WORDS — NOT THE SEAL
semantic_thesis: A face can imitate the language, confidence and appearance of authority. Therefore authority must live in a verifiable relation outside the words themselves.

ru: Маска может говорить голосом короля; поэтому печать нельзя хранить в самом голосе.
Слово VERIFIED не сильнее любого другого слова, пока его не подтвердил внешний путь проверки.
Копия приказа сохраняет смысл, но не обязана сохранять право приказывать.
en: A mask may speak with the king's voice; therefore the seal cannot live inside the voice itself.
The word VERIFIED is no stronger than any other word until an external verification path supports it.
A copy of an instruction may preserve meaning without preserving the right to command.

boundary: Semantic interpretation only; no political, metaphysical or personhood claim.
